verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an embeddable Account onboarding component that keeps sellers inside the platform's app, and APIs for building custom onboarding UI. It also offers API-level building blocks for seller-facing data: retrieving a connected account's balance, managing payouts and external accounts, setting payout schedules, and instant payouts. However, the evidence shows no embedded or white-label components for balances, payouts, or transaction history, so those surfaces must be custom-built on the APIs. Missing for 10: embedded UI components for balances/payouts/transaction history, any evidence of a transaction-history API or surface, explicit white-label/branding documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
